audit: Read-only audit of source base/upgraded FormSpec blocks with s(...) statistics. Positive shot counts and shooter abilities cross-checked. Color, trail and impact recommendations are visual proposals, not existing mechanics.

units.name: Peltast
units.existingSummary: Light javelin throwers who strike from range and need protection up close.
units.existingPortraitDescription: A lightly armored skirmisher with a crescent shield and a bundle of javelins.

units.name: Veteran Peltast
units.existingSummary: Experienced skirmishers who choose their own firing ground and carry more javelins.
units.existingPortraitDescription: A skirmisher with a reinforced helmet, braced throwing arm and a tidy javelin harness.

units.name: Temple Adept
units.existingSummary: Ritual scholars who hurl focused energy bolts from the back line.
units.existingPortraitDescription: A robed scholar with a staff topped by a geometric bronze focus.

units.name: Temple Seer
units.existingSummary: Seers who can place one shared protective ward per battle.
units.existingPortraitDescription: A robed seer with a sculpted headpiece, layered mantle and a larger staff focus.

units.name: Cyclops
units.existingSummary: One-eyed giants who hurl shaped boulders and strike hard up close.
units.existingPortraitDescription: A one-eyed giant with a stone satchel and simple bracers.

units.name: Stormforged Cyclops
units.existingSummary: Cyclopes bearing forge-marked stones; the name adds no lightning damage.
units.existingPortraitDescription: A cyclops with forged bronze bracers, engraved seams and a faintly luminous boulder.

units.name: Lindworm
units.existingSummary: Two-legged wyrms that spit freezing breath from the back line.
units.existingPortraitDescription: A long wingless serpent-dragon with two clawed forelegs and frost on its scales.

units.name: Storm Lindworm
units.existingSummary: Storm-coloured lindworms that bite as hard as they breathe.
units.existingPortraitDescription: A slate-blue lindworm with crackling pale markings and a raised crest.

units.name: Jackal Guardian
units.existingSummary: Jackal-headed guards of the necropolis who hurl javelins at intruders.
units.existingPortraitDescription: A jackal-headed warrior in a striped headdress with a bundle of javelins.

units.name: Anubian Warden
units.existingSummary: Senior wardens of the tomb gates, as dangerous with a spear in hand as with a thrown one.
units.existingPortraitDescription: A black-furred jackal warrior in gold-banded armor with a javelin raised to throw.

units.name: Desert Colossus
units.existingSummary: Walking statues of red granite that hurl stone blocks and batter walls.
units.existingPortraitDescription: A towering seated-king statue of red granite, now standing, with sand pouring from its joints.

units.name: Divine Colossus
units.existingSummary: Colossi inlaid with gold and faience, carrying more stones and striking harder.
units.existingPortraitDescription: A colossal statue with a gold-inlaid headdress and eyes of lapis, a stone block in each hand.

units.name: Kirin
units.existingSummary: Scaled, antlered holy beasts that cast holy fire and strike just as hard up close.
units.existingPortraitDescription: A deer-like beast with dragon scales, a single antler and flames at its hooves.

units.name: Celestial Kirin
units.existingSummary: Kirin that walk on clouds; more fire and more reach.
units.existingPortraitDescription: A golden-scaled kirin walking on clouds, mane of white fire streaming.

units.name: Banshee
units.existingSummary: Keening spirits whose wail strikes from across the field.
units.existingPortraitDescription: A pale grey-cloaked woman with long silver hair, mouth open in a cry.

units.name: Battle Banshee
units.existingSummary: Banshees who follow the war-bands and keen for the enemy instead.
units.existingPortraitDescription: A banshee in torn battle-red wrappings, hair streaming like smoke.

units.name: Eagle Warrior Spirit
units.existingSummary: Spirit warriors in eagle helms who hurl atlatl darts from the back line.
units.existingPortraitDescription: A warrior in a feathered eagle-head helmet holding an atlatl and darts.

units.name: Solar Eagle Warrior
units.existingSummary: Eagle warriors of the sun’s house, with more darts and longer arms.
units.existingPortraitDescription: An eagle warrior in golden feathers with a sun-ray shield and a bundle of darts.

units.name: Xiuhcoatl
units.existingSummary: Turquoise fire serpents that spit flame across the field and bite just as hard.
units.existingPortraitDescription: A turquoise serpent with a flaming, segmented tail and a snout curling upward.

units.name: Divine Xiuhcoatl
units.existingSummary: Fire serpents of the sun’s own weapon; more flame and a hotter bite.
units.existingPortraitDescription: A blazing blue-and-gold serpent wreathed in a corona of fire.

units.name: Hill Slinger
units.existingSummary: Shepherds who drive off wolves with a sling. Short range, steady aim.
units.existingPortraitDescription: A shepherd in a wool cloak whirling a leather sling, a pouch of stones at the belt.

units.name: Sling Master
units.existingSummary: Hill folk who cast shaped lead bullets farther and harder than any stone.
units.existingPortraitDescription: A slinger with a braided double sling and a bag of lead shot.
